translations.web: For whoever has, to him more will be given, and he who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.”
translations.bsb: For whoever has will be given more. But whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.”
translations.kjv: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.
translations.asv: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken away even that which he hath.
